verdicts.quote: One invalid row means no user is created
The page shows that nothing was created and lists every problem with its row number, column and reason.
A row whose email already belongs to an existing user is invalid … A repeated email within the file is invalid on its second and later occurrences
A role value, compared without regard to case (`Member`, `ADMIN`), that is neither `member` nor `admin` makes the row invalid
verdicts.missing: Whether each requested role must also fall within the importing admin’s own authority to grant access.

verdicts.quote: A signed-in user whose role is not `admin` who requests the import page or sends an upload receives HTTP status 403
verdicts.missing: Whether permission to create one user is independent of permission to import users in bulk.

verdicts.quote: a file with no header row or missing required columns … If it has no `email` column, or no `name` column, the file is refused … Columns other than `email`, `name` and `role` are ignored and reported
The file is read as UTF-8, with an optional byte-order mark ignored … A field wrapped in double quotes may contain commas, line breaks, and doubled double quotes … Records end with LF, CRLF or CR.
Invitations are sent after the users are saved … the set of users is as before, no invitation is sent
A file of 1,048,577 bytes or more is refused with a message that states the limit "1 MiB"; for an API caller the status is 413.
An empty file is refused … A file with a header but no data rows is refused … A fully valid file creates exactly one user per row

re-uploads a file that already succeeded … Each email ends up with exactly one account; the upload that cannot create an account for some email is refused as a whole with the reason "already exists" for that row.
shows the success result of C-36 in no more than 30 seconds … the processing runs inside a single web request
verdicts.missing: The admin sees completion in the upload response. A background job and a way to learn its outcome after that request ends are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Each new user receives exactly one invitation email … The success response of C-36 is shown without waiting for the emails to be delivered.
verdicts.missing: Whether all invitations are dispatched at once or at a defined rate, and what that rate is.

verdicts.quote: in the active state … No password is taken from the file, and new users cannot sign in until they set one … opens the link in it, chooses a password, and is then able to sign in
After the response, the uploaded file is not available anywhere in the application (not retrievable by any URL, not stored in the import record).
sees each attempt with who ran it, when, the file name and the outcome, opens one, and sees the users it created or the errors it produced.
The page shows that nothing was created and lists every problem with its row number, column and reason. The admin corrects the file and uploads it again.
verdicts.missing: Whether an admin can cancel an in-progress import or select only failed rows for retry.

verdicts.quote: Uploading a valid file of 1,000 rows (each with email, name and role, at most 1 MiB) shows the success result of C-36 in no more than 30 seconds
verdicts.missing: What progress the admin sees between submission and the final result.

verdicts.quote: No existing user is updated, deactivated or deleted by an import.
verdicts.missing: Whether the existing workflow for creating a single user by hand must retain its current behavior.

verdicts.quote: A row is invalid with an error on column `name` if the name, after trimming, is empty or longer than 200 characters. … including apostrophes, hyphens, non-ASCII letters and a leading `=`.
verdicts.missing: How to keep a formula-like value literal if an import result is opened in a spreadsheet.
